name: Golden Grants
tagline: A Chrome extension that checks a nonprofit's eligibility for a grant page and drafts its application sections.
problem: Small nonprofits without grant writers lose hours to bureaucratic grant pages and sometimes do not apply.
solution: Builds an organisation profile, checks eligibility against live grant-page text, summarises requirements, extracts deadlines and documents, drafts common sections, and keeps an exportable history.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a grant page and see eligibility, deadlines and a draft response.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Snowflake API” among 77 submissions.
Analysis happens on the grant page itself, with no copy-pasting.

lessons: Meet users inside the page they already work on.
